title: A product family built around the journey
subtitle: Eleven products across six stages — from free audit to verified savings
a11yLabel: The WattZap product family in four groups: EnergyScan diagnostics, the Guard protection family, optimise and generate products, and finance and prove products.

cards.heading: Diagnose — EnergyScan
bullets: EnergyScan Lite: free first check from one bill
Every finding carries value, payback and confidence

cards.heading: Protect — the Guards
bullets: PF Guard and Demand Guard stop recurring penalties
Bill Guard checks every bill line by line
Solar Guard watches existing solar performance

cards.heading: Optimise & Generate
bullets: WattZap Edge connects meters and machines securely
EMS Lite: live monitoring, plain-language alerts
SolarFit sizes solar from the real load profile

cards.heading: Finance & Prove
bullets: SolarLease: solar without heavy upfront investment
Savings Assurance verifies savings against baselines
Models run from free audit to monthly subscription

content.note: Product access is entitlement-controlled — nothing is charged without a written proposal the customer approves.
